Describe the Data-Generating Process Population

Source: R/dat_gen_functions.R
describe_population.Rd

Utility function to explore how different simulation factors (bias pattern, residual variance heterogeneity, R-squared) interact to produce the population-level properties of the surrogate predictions. Generates a large population (or accepts an existing data frame) and summarizes the variance of bias, average residual variance, proportion of error due to bias, and achieved R-squared.

describe_population(
  n_strat,
  strata_config = c("balanced-exact", "balanced-approx", "unbalanced"),
  tau = 0,
  bias = c("none", "small", "moderate", "large", "extreme-contrast"),
  residual_var = c("homogeneous", "heterogeneous", "extreme-contrast"),
  sd_y = 3,
  R2_target = 0.5,
  no_tx = FALSE,
  rescale_v = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

n_strat

Integer specifying the number of strata, or a data frame (output of generate_population) to summarize directly.

strata_config

Character. How to allocate units across strata: "balanced-exact" (equal sizes, requires N divisible by n_strat), "balanced-approx" (approximately equal via random assignment), or "unbalanced" (random proportions).

tau

Numeric. Constant additive treatment effect. Default is 0 (no treatment effect).

bias

Character. Level of systematic prediction bias across strata: "none", "small" (up to 25% of sd_y), "moderate" (up to 50%), "large" (up to 100%), or "extreme-contrast" (bias concentrated in two strata).

residual_var

Character. Pattern of residual variance across strata: "homogeneous" (equal variance), "heterogeneous" (linearly increasing), or "extreme-contrast" (one very high, one very low).

sd_y

Numeric. Standard deviation of the outcome variable. Default is 3.

R2_target

Numeric between 0 and 1. Target R-squared for the surrogate predictions. Controls overall prediction quality. Default is 0.5.

no_tx

Logical. If TRUE, do not generate treatment assignment; all units receive control potential outcomes. Useful for single-arm designs. Default is FALSE.

rescale_v

Logical. If TRUE, rescale residual variances to preserve the target R-squared exactly. Default is TRUE.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints formatted tables of stratum-level and aggregate summaries. Default is FALSE.

Value

A one-row tibble with columns: Z (treatment arm), Var_b (variance of stratum-level biases), E_sig2 (expected within-stratum residual variance), prop_bias (proportion of prediction error due to bias), and R2 (achieved R-squared of surrogate predictions).
